companyBrief.title: Precision-Engineered Kitchen Infrastructure Since 2014
companyBrief.desc1: PT. Limars Teknik Indonesia is a full-service commercial kitchen engineering firm specializing in precision stainless steel fabrication, certified gas piping systems, and integrated MEP solutions. With over a decade of field-proven expertise, we engineer kitchen infrastructure built for operational durability and safety compliance.
companyBrief.desc2: Every project is backed by in-house fabrication capabilities, rigorous pressure testing protocols, and a dedicated engineering team — ensuring your kitchen systems perform reliably under the most demanding conditions.

products.title: Our Products
products.subtitle: Discover our wide range of commercial kitchen equipment, from traditional cooking solutions to modern technology.

services.title: Integrated Engineering Solutions
services.subtitle: End-to-end technical solutions engineered for safety compliance, operational durability, and peak performance — from certified gas piping and ducting systems to precision-fabricated kitchen infrastructure.

why.title: Engineering Excellence
why.subtitle: Precision-driven processes, safety-first protocols, and a vertically integrated engineering approach that sets us apart.

items.fabrication_desc: Our dedicated fabrication facility utilizes CNC-grade processes and premium SS 304/316L stainless steel to manufacture equipment with tight tolerances and consistent quality control.
items.compliance_desc: Every installation undergoes rigorous HSE protocols, certified gas pressure testing, and ducting integrity assessments — ensuring full regulatory compliance before handover.
items.engineering_desc: Our projects are led by qualified technical engineers, not general contractors. From load calculations to system commissioning, every phase is engineered to specification.
items.mfg_desc: Design, fabrication, installation, and commissioning — all executed in-house. This vertical integration eliminates coordination gaps and ensures accountability at every stage.
items.custom_desc: We don't sell off-the-shelf. Every system is custom-engineered to your site conditions, operational flow, and specific compliance requirements.
items.support_desc: Our commitment extends beyond installation — scheduled maintenance programs, rapid-response repairs, and system performance audits keep your kitchen running at peak efficiency.

quotes.3: The precision fabrication quality of Limars equipment is exceptional — built for industrial durability. Their lifecycle support program ensures our systems maintain peak performance year after year.

About.heroSubtitle: We are PT. Limars Teknik Indonesia — Indonesia's trusted artisan oven builder and commercial kitchen infrastructure specialist.
About.visionDesc: To be Indonesia's #1 specialist builder and manufacturer of traditional artisan ovens and refractory thermal engineering, setting the benchmark for commercial kitchen infrastructure excellence.

missionList.1: Engineer and construct high-performance wood-fired pizza ovens, Mandi ovens, Tannurs, and Kamados with precise heat retention above 500°C
missionList.2: Deliver comprehensive commercial kitchen infrastructure solutions (Stainless Steel Fabrication, Gas Piping, Ducting, & MEP) that ensure operational safety and durability
missionList.3: Innovate accessible portable pizza oven lines to empower culinary SMEs and modern portable restaurants across Indonesia
missionList.4: Provide dedicated technical support, precision commissioning, and long-term partnerships for every commercial food service operator

About.journeySubtitle: A decade of proven project milestones and dedicated kitchen engineering since 2014.

2014.title: Inception & First Project
2014.desc: Limars Teknik was founded in Jakarta and immediately commissioned to build its first Gold Mosaic Wood-Fired Pizza Oven at Zahra Al-Jazeerah Cianjur.

2015.title: Middle Eastern Mandi Oven Mastery
2015.desc: Entrusted by Al-Jazeerah Cikini & Central Pramuka restaurant groups to engineer heavy-duty custom Lamb Mandi & Arab Bread ovens.

2016.title: Giant 180cm Dome Oven & Puncak Tannur
2016.desc: Completed a giant 180cm diameter dome pizza oven for Al-Jazeerah Polonia Function Hall and a pit-style Tannur oven at Royal Al-Jazeerah Puncak.

2018.title: Japanese Kamado & Nanamia Pizzeria
2018.desc: Engineered a custom Japanese Kamado hearth for Dashi Chazuke Grand Indonesia, Istanbul Turkey Kemang oven, and Nanamia Pizzeria Jogja.

2021.title: Enduring Restaurant Partnerships
2021.desc: Continued partnership with wood-fired oven builds for Nanamia Pizzeria Yogyakarta Branch 2 (2021) and Branch 3 (2023).

2025.title: Digital Transformation & Portable Ovens
2025.desc: Initiated the 2025 digital transformation era while developing affordable Portable Oven series for culinary SMEs and modern eateries.
